Load saved enrichment results

Source: R/demeter_result_loaders.R
DEMETER_load_enrichment.Rd

Loads a gost_enrichment object (from APOLLO_enrich_gost()) that was saved by the user via saveRDS(), or reconstructs a partial object from a flat CSV export. RDS is the recommended format: it preserves the complete object including per-module gost objects and metadata. CSV reconstruction is provided as a fallback — only the $combined data.frame is restored; per-module gost objects and $metadata are unavailable.

Usage

DEMETER_load_enrichment(file_path, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

file_path

Character. Path to an .rds or .csv file. For CSV, the file must contain at minimum the columns: term_id, term_name, source, p_value, module (i.e., the $combined output from APOLLO_enrich_gost()).

verbose

Logical. Print loading summary. Default: TRUE.

Value

A gost_enrichment S3 object (list) with elements:

results

Named list of raw gprofiler2 gost objects (RDS only; empty list when loading from CSV)

combined

Combined data.frame of all results across all modules

summary

Summary data.frame of term counts (RDS only; NULL from CSV)

metadata

List of analysis parameters including organism and sources (RDS only; partially inferred from CSV)

See also

APOLLO_enrich_gost, AETHER_plot_go_treemap

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Save enrichment result after running the analysis
gost_res <- APOLLO_enrich_gost(gene_lists, sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG"))
saveRDS(gost_res, "results/enrichment/gost_results.rds")

# Reload in a fresh session
gost_res <- DEMETER_load_enrichment("results/enrichment/gost_results.rds")

# Plot GO treemap from reloaded object
AETHER_plot_go_treemap(gost_res, ont = "BP")
} # }
